_comment: Zabbix item NAMES the Grafana dashboards and the daily reports look for. Edit here (never in a dashboard) to support another vendor, then regenerate: node tools/monitoring/build.mjs && grafana-report build-dashboards --apply. Names are literal text; 'contains' matches a substring, 'exact' the whole name. ORDER = PRECEDENCE: for each device the FIRST name that matches any of its items is used and later names are ignored for that device, so a device with both a vendor item and a generic one never shows two series (vendor-specific names first, generic last). Only items that already hold a PERCENTAGE may be listed: raw counters (e.g. 'Huawei - Memory Raw') are refused. Zabbix does the SNMP polling and preprocessing (walk[...] + regex on the right instance); Grafana only reads the processed numeric item by NAME. A device without a matching item shows N/A, nothing is invented.
